does_not_prove: The text is short (58 to 81 words) and it is not a full project page. How well the form is filled for full pages is measured by Test 1 (design 13.2), not here.
It does not show that the quotes are right. The check of the quotes is Phase D (design 6.3). The count of quotes found in the text is only an observation.
The search layer is checked with the card form only. Its own form, the comparison of projects, is built in Phase D.

One call per model. The speed, the quota and the cost of a full run are not shown. Gemini 3.1 Pro is a public preview model: Google may change or retire it, and its quota may be lower than that of a generally available model.
The price of the embedding model was not read from Google, so only its token count is reported.
